title: [research tooling] Concurrent writers to research/queue/*.yaml strand PRs: dispatcher last_dispatched_at stamps and research-queue-grade blocks conflict with hand-grade PRs, and vice versa
note: MEASURED 2026-11-20: (1) hand-grade PR #27745 conflicted twice in ~40 min with dispatcher stamp commits (last_dispatched_at at 09:00Z and 09:07Z on 4 units); each needed a manual merge of main and a full CI cycle (~15 min). (2) research-queue-grade run 44697854258 failed: its output PR #27735 hit failed_conflict for 80 min because W47b's hand re-grades of 9e1c-12/abab-28/abab-29 landed in between. ML-15 fixed both by hand (merge main, keep the newer hand grade). Candidate fix: write last_dispatched_at and auto-grade blocks to a sidecar (e.g. research/queue/.state/<id>.json) that hand-grades never touch, or have the automation refresh step resolve stamp-only conflicts by taking both sides. Gates this adds or changes: none.
